entities.summary: Nakhchivan Tepe (Naxçıvantəpə) is a Chalcolithic settlement in Nakhchivan, Azerbaijan. It is located in Nakhchivan and is dated to around 5000 BC. It is on the right bank of the Nakhchivançay River at an altitude of 850m.
